input: Commission a custom illustration for the living room wall

gold.taskTitle: Commission a Custom Living Room Wall Illustration
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to hire an artist to create a custom illustration specifically sized and styled for display on their living room wall.

questions.title: What size do you need the illustration to be?
questions.description: Understanding the exact dimensions will determine artist requirements, printing needs, and budget.

questions.title: Do you have a specific subject or theme in mind?
questions.description: Knowing the subject matter helps identify the right artist style and narrows the creative brief.

questions.title: What illustration style are you drawn to?
questions.description: For example: watercolor, line art, digital, oil, abstract, realistic, botanical, etc.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this commission?
questions.description: Budget directly affects which artists can be approached and whether framing or printing costs are included.

questions.title: Do you want a physical original or a high-resolution digital file?
questions.description: This affects delivery format, shipping, printing, and how the piece will ultimately be displayed.

questions.title: Have you already found an artist, or do you need help sourcing one?
questions.description: Knowing whether an artist is chosen determines whether the next steps are outreach or discovery.

questions.title: What is your deadline for having this piece on the wall?
questions.description: Commissions can take weeks to months, so a target date shapes how urgently the search and brief must move.
